name: Paludal-Threnody
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past a tidally locked hemisphere, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Forests of black-leaved flora drink the dim light and exhale a scent like cold iron.
Approach protocols for the quarantine zone are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
The quarantine perimeter has held for years, mostly out of mutual disinterest. Everyone checks the fence anyway.
